name: Auto Pins (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1953, Auto Pins India Ltd manufactures and trades loose leaf springs, iron and steel[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
APIL specializes in design, development and manufacture of Leaf & Parabolic Springs and Automotive Components under the brand name of SIROCCO. It is an Original Equipment supplier to many vehicle manufacturers. It has served 761+ customers in 12 countries

cons: Stock is trading at 9.36 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.5% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.64% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 39.3 to 48.4 days.
